topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: Optimal feed element spacing balances gain and interference, considering MVDR beamforming's robustness against feed failures. Discrete phase shifter settings and aperture efficiency impact this trade-off, influencing system capacity. Element pattern tapering enhances capacity by mitigating interference, while mutual coupling affects array performance.
reference_context: Defocused reflector concepts offer robustness against feed failures, with MVDR beamforming minimizing gain loss.
